card.thesis: Round 44 passive cell. Basket (realassets): wsaj's and Creator C's EM/commodity/energy/Korea rotation thesis, expressed as two energy-sector SPDRs (XOP, XME), one Korea-country ETF (EWY) and one broad emerging-markets ETF (VWO) -- a proxy for the rotation DESTINATION, not wsaj's own named EWZ/TSM/IYR (TSM would collide with the semicap basket's theme; EWZ/IYR are not this field's GFC-eligible, disjoint-clean instruments). Universe: XOP XME EWY VWO. Purpose ROTH: no ticker this round trades is claimed by any savings- or trading-purpose card in the live library (app.evolution.promotion._library_cards, all six tiers), because Rev. Rul. 2008-5 destroys rather than defers a wash-sale loss whose replacement is bought inside an IRA. Five of these twenty names (AMAT, KLAC, LRCX, XOP, XME) ARE already held by other roth-purpose cards elsewhere in the library -- legal and disclosed: find_disjointness_violations only ever compares a roth card against the TAXABLE universe, and roth-to-roth overlap creates no wash-sale exposure under Rev. Rul. 2008-5, since nothing is ever repurchased inside the taxable book. Ticker disjointness from the taxable book is NECESSARY, not sufficient, under IRC section 1091; nothing here is a section 1091-safety claim. The Roth benchmark is SPY, price-only, no dividends -- none of these five baskets is a US large-cap-growth book, so a raw adjusted_excess-vs-SPY reading is not this round's decision quantity for any basket; the decision quantities are basket-minus-control (does the theme beat a broad passive control, held passively) and trim-minus-passive (does stepping a name to cash above its own 200-day*1.15 extension beat holding it). Every note in the persona corpus that produced this hypothesis has published=null (PERSONA-HYPOTHESES.md), so the bull-2024 and recent windows are IN-SAMPLE to the hypothesis and any positive result confined to them is hindsight, not a finding -- the fair test is the six windows ending by 2022-10 (gfc, chop-2011, chop-2015, q4-2018, covid, bear-2022), reported separately. Pre-registered 2026-09-09, before any card ran. Not investment advice; no influencer is endorsed. See strategy-program/ROUND-44-PLAN.md.
card.falsification: Pre-registered decision rule (PROTOCOL.md section 7 floor, 21.2pp): a basket edge requires median(r44-realassets-passive) minus median(r44-control-passive) > 21.2pp AND BH q<0.10 over all 10 cells this round runs; a trim edge requires median(r44-realassets-trim) minus median(r44-realassets-passive) > 21.2pp AND the same BH q<0.10. A margin inside the floor is a null whichever side it lands on, and the pre-registered prediction is null on both axes (39 prior rounds found every basket- and rule-margin this programme has ever measured inside this floor). This is the basket-question card. Predicted worst window: covid for realassets and power (both hold a commodity/rate-sensitive name that gapped hardest in the March 2020 crash); chop-2011/chop-2015 for defense and semicap (trendless whipsaw against a buy-and-hold-forever position has no mechanism to hurt it, so its own worst window is structural, not thematic). Nothing is promoted from this round regardless of outcome.
